name: prompt-transform
description: An Optimize button above the prompt box (and /optimize) for Claude: it rewrites your prompt by Anthropic's prompting advice, which it re-reads daily to keep its rules current; picks the Claude model and effort for the task from a benchmark routing table, switching a long task from the planning model to a cheaper one mid-task; and names the skills and MCP tools the work needs, sending web searches and scrapes to a Firecrawl on your own machine when you run one. It also compacts a long thread, adds deny rules for files Claude never needs, switches off plugins no chat has used in 14 days and switches one on when a prompt needs it, and daily flags idle MCP servers, missing context-mode and RTK, and CLAUDE.md files over 200 lines; beside a one-bar meter of how warm the prompt cache is. It keeps Claude's skills up to date. Claude Code's own web searches go to that local Firecrawl too, or to a local stand-in for Exa.
